title: Playing cards with enums
description:
Model a deck of cards with enums and a record.

```
52 cards
Top 5 after shuffling: 7♣ K♥ 2♦ A♠ 10♥
Highest: A♠
Hearts in the top 5: 2
```
hints: `enum Rank { TWO(2, "2"), ..., ACE(14, "A"); ... }` with two fields and a constructor (lesson 3.05).
The highest card: loop over the top five, keep the best card so far, and replace it when a card's `rank().value` is higher.
requirements: `enum Suit` with a symbol, and `enum Rank` with a value from 2 to 14 (ace high).
`record Card(Rank rank, Suit suit)` with a `toString()` like `10♥`.
Build the deck from `Suit.values()` and `Rank.values()`; shuffle with `Collections.shuffle(deck, new Random(7))`. Your five cards will not be the ones in the example.
stretch: Make `Card` implement `Comparable<Card>` and sort a hand by rank, then suit.
